get.description:
Use this method to retrieve all of the violations for the client specified by the 'clientId'.

 Optional parameters: 

 'startDate': Optional GET parameter that applies to DateCreated of Violations. If only startdate is provided, end date will be nothing. The format is MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss. 

 'endDate': Optional GET parameter that applies to DateCreated of Violations. If only endate is provided, results will include everything up to enddate. The format is MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss. 

 URI Examples:

 /client/{clientId}/violations?startDate=01-01-2023

 /client/{clientId}/violations/all?startDate=01-01-2022&endDate=01-01-2023
 /client/{clientId}/violations/all?startDate=01-01-2022 11:11:30&endDate=01-01-2023 14:11:00
